names.note: Read out of saint.gr's line for 25 Ιανουαρίου, «Όσιος Μάρης», with the rank word left off.

Read out of the Ohrid Prologue's own heading for 25. јануар ст. ст. (civil 2026-02-07), „Преподобни Мар“. The rank word „Преподобни“ is left off and the heading gives no epithet, so the form stands bare — the Prologue names no city for him. Its body matches the folder's Greek source on the man: a hermit of great beauty and sweet voice who spent thirty-seven years in a hut and died at ninety, in 430 by the Prologue's reckoning and in the fourth century by saint.gr's; the two are not reconciled here.

death.note: saint.gr: «Έζησε συνολικά ενενήντα χρόνια και απεβίωσε ειρηνικά τον 4ο αιώνα μ.Χ.»
